parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Http2
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable `HTTP/2`.

*   `open`: `HTTP/2` is enabled.
*   `close`: `HTTP/2` is disabled.
*   `globalConfig`: Global configurations are used.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name that you want to update.

parameters.name: MustHttps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly use HTTPS.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The type of the protocol. Valid values:

*   HTTPS
*   HTTP

parameters.name: TlsMax
parameters.description: The maximum version of Transport Layer Security (TLS).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-domain --protocol HTTPS --must-https false --cert-identifier 6209108-cn-hangzhou --id 94 --gateway-unique-id gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000 --http2 close --tls-max TLS_1.3 --tls-min TLS_1.0 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateGatewayDomain --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000' --Http2 close --TlsMax 'TLS_1.3' --MustHttps false --CertIdentifier '6209108-cn-hangzhou' --TlsMin 'TLS_1.0' --AcceptLanguage zh --Id 94 --Protocol HTTPS
